item.title: Lagos: Police deploy over 5,000 officers for Christmas, New Year festivities

item.title: NNL fines Gombe United N2.5m for crowd troubles
item.description: The Nigeria National League, NNL, imposed a fine of N2.5m on Gombe United following fans encroachment, harassment and intimidation of match officials. The league body said Gombe United breached multiple regulations, including failing to provide adequate security and control of their supporters.
